programme.title: AJ Rafael: Take Me Back Tour From Gramercy Theatre
programme.desc: Experience AJ Rafael’s heartfelt “Take Me Back Tour” live from New York City’s Gramercy Theatre. Blending nostalgia and artistry, AJ performs fan favorites and new tracks including “Take Me Back,” “Showstopper,” and “I Just Want You.” Through soulful storytelling, intimate moments, and emotional performances, AJ reflects on his journey from the early Myspace and YouTube days to becoming one of the most beloved independent singer-songwriters of his generation.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani
programme.desc: In this course, Anita Moorjani guides you toward loving yourself as if your life depends on it – because it does! When love (rather than fear) determines your life, you will recognize what is truly important for you to be happy and healthy.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani
programme.desc: Today, Anita shares what her near-death experience taught her about how to live. You’ll discover why everything we have learned through our education system, government, mass media, etc. is the exact opposite of what we should know in order to create a meaningful, joy-filled life.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani
programme.desc: Today, we take a close look at who we really are in order to recognize our purpose, understand our intentions, and recognize our true worth in this world.

programme.title: The Wright Turn
programme.desc: La Dolce Vita (Sweet Life) - Ten years after the divorce from Maxwell Turner, with children grown, Celeste Wright Turner makes a choice to start living her life. No SEX with the EX! Simon and Mimi try to get Celeste’s head on straight when it comes to Maxwell’s charm. After facing an emotional challenge, Celeste decides to take a trip abroad.

programme.title: The Wright Turn
programme.desc: London Bridges Burning Down - Breakdowns are inevitable when Celeste tries to run from her past. Her therapist gives Celeste sound advice on how to spice up her sex life.

programme.title: The Wright Turn
programme.desc: Butter Me Up - Celeste returns back to Los Angeles after her journey. Her friends throw her a sex toy birthday party. When an old flame comes back, can he melt her butter? Nikki reveals a trauma from her childhood.

programme.title: The Wright Turn
programme.desc: Pearl Necklace - Can a long-desired gift bring Max and Celeste closer together? While Father Cross’s guilty pleasure is exposed, leaving a young family member seeking revenge and Celeste on his trail. A Fundraiser brings Maddy back to the stage with new comic material on the stage of Denim & Diamonds fundraiser for Autism Care Today.

programme.title: Sex Talk
programme.desc: The science of falling in love, plus putting the spark back into your sex life. Also, there are some health benefits to “going commando” but there are some things you always must keep in mind.

programme.title: Sex Talk
programme.desc: Does Marijuana increase or decrease your libido? And is pregnancy brain a real thing? Plus is it possible to overdose on ED medications and a look at just what happens during vaginal rejuvenation procedures?

programme.title: Sex Talk
programme.desc: Did you know anger can negatively affect your performance in the bedroom? And despite what you may have heard oral sex isn’t always safe sex? Plus, don’t think you can’t get pregnant just because you’re still breastfeeding.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Judy Wilkins-Smith, a highly regarded systemic executive coach, trainer, facilitator, and Family Constellations expert. She shares her knowledge of neuroscience, epigenetics, and genealogy and talks about how families can end limiting cycles and reframe challenges into lasting breakthroughs and peak performance. Her book is Decoding Your Emotional Blueprint: A Powerful Guide to Transformation Through Disentangling Multigenerational Patterns.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr Sue Morter and Anat Baniel who are experts in energy methods which help us to live abundantly healthy lives. International speaker and Master of Bio-Energetic Theory, Dr. Sue Morter utilizes the embodiment of high-frequency energy patterns to activate full human potential. Anat Baniel, founder of Anat Baniel Method NeuroMovement, has developed a method, supported by brain science, that powerfully taps into our brain’s enormous potential for change and learning.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Jim Blake, best-selling author of The Zen Executive. Known for his wise and compassionate leadership skills, Jim has held numerous executive positions in the corporate world, and is currently the CEO of Unity World Headquarters. He shares experiences of bosses who led by fear and how he gleaned that there must be a better way. He developed a leadership style of cooperation, rather than competition. He discusses the importance of employees feeling seen and heard and offers suggestions for building strong teams and relationships.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Machiel Klerk, licensed mental health therapist and dream expert. He is the author of Dream Guidance – Connecting to the Soul Through Dream Incubation. He discusses five steps to easily build and nurture a relationship with your dreams through the conscious effort of dream incubation. He has travelled the world and studied many cultures and their healing traditions, specifically their dream technologies.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.desc: Celebrity hypnotist Tim Shurr helps you unlock happiness and shed anxiety. Shari tests her hypnotizability, and the story of a woman who took back her mental health by empowering women worldwide. Plus, live from Heartfulness headquarters in India.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.desc: 1963 Playboy Icon and Cosby Survivor, Victoria Valentino, shares her journey of overcoming unimaginable circumstances leading her to activism and purpose. Plus, one man's heroic efforts to save a tiny, unconscious life, and fun street interviews from NYC.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.desc: 3x GRAMMY winner, J. Ivy, shares his transformation from a shy kid to a spoken word powerhouse. J. Ivy performs. Plus, a story about a bus driver who made a first grader's day, street interviews from NYC, and Daaji discusses the soul's evolution.

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: Do you feel both captivated and exhausted by city life? Are the conveniences worth the chaos? In this episode of the Rooted in Wellness podcast, join me, Wade Lightheart, and Matt Gallant as we explore the challenges of maintaining balance in busy urban environments and the serene contrast of ashram life.

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: Have you wondered how to biohack your health as a woman? Taking control to live your best life is what we dive into in this episode with guest Aggie Lal.

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: If your mind feels foggy or unfocused, your food could be the missing piece. Mona unpacks how nutrition impacts your brain, mood, and energy—offering simple shifts to nourish your body and sharpen your mind from the inside out.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: Suffering has deep social causes. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains how your physiology is impacted by stress and social determinants.

programme.title: BREAD. AN EVERYDAY MIRACLE
programme.desc: Bread is a branded product with an endless number of varieties and providers. But do we actually know what we eat every day? How can traditional bakery skills survive? And how will the future of bread look like?
